public_payload.normalized_proposition: ChatGPT could not generate a tree on top of a monkey, even after acknowledging its own error.

statement.excerpt: The system stubbornly insists on tree growing out of (rather than on top of the) monkey, which is not what I asked for. It recognizes its own error but still can’t get the image right:
statement.document_title: Image generation: Still crazy after all these years

from_speaker: asked ChatGPT to draw a tree on top of monkey
stubbornly insists on tree growing out of (rather than on top of the) monkey
recognizes its own error but still can't get the image right
our_interpretation: The claim describes one ChatGPT conversation he had around June 2025.
It holds if, in that conversation, ChatGPT kept drawing a tree growing out of the monkey instead of resting on top of it, and also said in text that it had made this error.
criteria.support_condition: An independent record of that conversation, or a reproduction from the same period, shows ChatGPT admitting the error in text and still producing images with the tree growing out of the monkey.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independent record shows that the conversation went differently, for example that ChatGPT did produce a tree on top of the monkey, or never admitted the error.
